name: reliant
description: AI-powered coding assistant with intelligent agents for professional software development
author: Reliant Labs <support@reliantlabs.io>

scripts.dev:fresh: rm -f ../.ports.json ../.instance-info && node scripts/kill-ports.js && npm run dev
scripts.build:backend: cd .. && go build -buildvcs=false -o dist/reliant.tmp ./cmd/reliant/ && mv dist/reliant.tmp dist/reliant
scripts.test: node --test test/backend-auth.test.js test/daemon-creds.test.js test/backend-manager-readiness.test.js test/backend-manager-orphan-cleanup.test.js test/menu-accelerators.test.js test/navigation-policy.test.js test/child-signals.test.js
scripts.build:alpha: npm run build:web:alpha && ../scripts/build-electron.sh mac && electron-builder --config electron-builder.alpha.js
scripts.dist:mac:dev: npm run build:web:alpha && ../scripts/build-electron.sh mac && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.dev.js
scripts.dist:mac:alpha: npm run build:web:alpha && ../scripts/build-electron.sh mac && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.alpha.js
